evidence: Overhauls CScriptWitness storage, transaction/block deserialization bounds, and interpreter accessors.
rationale: Eliminates a critical validation-time memory amplification and DoS risk where valid 4 MB blocks with tiny witness elements consumed over 100 MiB of memory and took nearly 300 ms to deserialize. Benchmarks demonstrate block deserialization peak memory falls from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB and deserialization time falls by over 93%.
